inspection.officer_note: Same shortfall again; spring visit may also have noted it. Shed door hanging off.

correspondence.msg: Tenant offers a replanting plan by July.

deciding.cultivation_breach: Growing season: 11 of 20 m2 cultivated, 55%, with the covered bed not counted. There is no exemption and the tenancy began in 2021, so no grace applies. Photos are present. Clear breach.
deciding.notice_ladder_met: The notices list is empty, so no warning has been served, no deadline has passed and there has been no reinspection. Clearly false.
deciding.next_action: An unexcused shortfall and an unmitigated unsafe shed (no action booked, no approval) with no warning yet point to warning_notice. The tenant's replanting offer gives a little doubt.
deciding.recurrence_count: The previous visit on 2024-04-15 was a logged low-cultivation case that got verbal advice. The officer note suggests a possible earlier spring entry. One versus two prior loggings is balanced.
deciding.uncultivated_extent: Uncultivated is 9 of 20 m2, 45%, so level 1 rather than the planned level 0. The plan's level 0 contradicts a clear breach, so the breach was kept.
